name: polski-b1
description: Подготовка к государственному экзамену по польскому языку B1

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-content.mjs && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs && pnpm --filter @polski/web dev
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-content.mjs && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs && pnpm --filter @polski/web build
scripts.content: node scripts/build-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/build-vocabulary.mjs && node scripts/sync-content.mjs
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-grammar.mjs && node scripts/validate-sentences.mjs && node scripts/validate-collocations.mjs && node scripts/build-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/build-vocabulary.mjs
scripts.test:exercise-ui: pnpm --filter @polski/engine exec vitest run --root ../../apps/web --globals tests/exercise-layout.test.js tests/answer-input.test.js tests/practice-keyboard.test.js tests/reading-catalog.test.js
scripts.test: node --test scripts/pack-reading.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @polski/engine test && pnpm test:exercise-ui
